sections.en: Separations of the Moon from the Sun

summary.headline: Moon-Jupiter Applications by Sign
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the Moon’s application to Jupiter after separation from the Sun in Libra, Scorpio, and Sagittarius, using conjunction, sextile, trine, square, and opposition. The forecasts address justice, rulers, scholars, merchants, commoners, religious disputes, plague, thieves, and conditions in Iraq, Balkh, Badakhshan, and Herat.
